turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyText:
Standard domestic and international orders can take up to **4 business days** to process before they ship and tracking starts updating.

Once a tracking number is issued, the first carrier scan can take a couple of days to show up. For full timeframes by shipping method, see [shipping options](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/shipping-options).

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyText:
It depends on the shipping method you choose at checkout:

- **Standard Shipping:** 3–7 business days  
- **2 Business Days (order by 3pm ET):** 2 business days  
- **1 Business Day (order by 3pm ET):** 1 business day  
- **UPS Saturday Delivery:** Saturday arrival (when offered at checkout)  
- **Same Day Delivery (LA only, order by 12pm PT):** same day  

Business days don’t include weekends or US holidays. Details: [shipping options](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/shipping-options).

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyText:
After checkout, the shipping method can’t be changed.

If you haven’t placed the order yet, the only way to get it sooner is to choose an expedited option at checkout (like 2 Business Days or 1 Business Day) if it shows as available for your address.

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyText:
If tracking never updates, it usually means either the carrier hasn’t done the first scan yet (can take a couple of days after the tracking number is issued) or the order is still processing (up to 4 business days).

If it’s past the delivery estimate and tracking is still stalled with no new scans, contact us and we can investigate. You can also check status here: [track your order](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/track-order).

- In your Fashion Nova account under **Orders**.
- Or use the self-serve page here: [track your order](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/track-order).
